F3: Between polls, the unconfirmed path goes to `_still_overdue` without replaying `_faulted`, so the RUN_OBSERVATION_FAILED fault disappears and `_close_recovered` closes the escalation until the next failed poll.
F4: The exception handler always returns True even when `escalate` writes nothing (deduplicated project escalation or node already blocked), so a persistent fault stops the host from idling and spins with an error log on every pass.
